expr: (((a.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray b x) ++ b.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray a x)).dedup.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))).toArray)

lemmas.name: inArray_iff
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array Int) (x : Int), inArray a x = true ↔ x ∈ a.toList
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro a x
  unfold inArray
  rw [← Array.any_toList, List.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    have : y = x := by simpa using hxy
    subst this; exact hy
  · intro h; exact ⟨x, h, by simp⟩

lemmas.name: diss22
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h : dissimilarElements_precond a b), dissimilarElements_postcond a b (((a.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray b x) ++ b.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray a x)).dedup.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))).toArray) h
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro a b h
  have hmem : ∀ x, x ∈ ((a.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray b x) ++ b.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray a x)).dedup.mergeSort
      (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))) ↔ (x ∈ a.toList ∧ x ∉ b.toList) ∨ (x ∈ b.toList ∧ x ∉ a.toList) := by
    intro x
    have hf : ∀ (c : Array Int) (y : Int), inArray c y = false ↔ y ∉ c.toList := by
      intro c y; rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, inArray_iff]
    rw [(List.mergeSort_perm _ _).mem_iff, List.mem_dedup, List.mem_append, List.mem_filter, List.mem_filter]
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true', hf]
  have hnd : ((a.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray b x) ++ b.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray a x)).dedup.mergeSort
      (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))).Nodup :=
    (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_dedup _)
  have hsort := List.pairwise_mergeSort' (· ≤ ·) ((a.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray b x) ++ b.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray a x)).dedup)
  unfold dissimilarElements_postcond
  rw [List.toList_toArray]
  refine ⟨?_, hsort, hnd, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Array.all_toList, List.toList_toArray, List.all_eq_true]
    intro x hx
    have := (hmem x).mp hx
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, ne_eq]
    intro heq
    rcases this with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · have := (inArray_iff a x).mpr h1; rw [heq] at this; exact h2 ((inArray_iff b x).mp this)
    · have := (inArray_iff b x).mpr h1; rw [← heq] at this; exact h2 ((inArray_iff a x).mp this)
  · rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true]
    intro x hx
    by_cases hb : x ∈ b.toList
    · have hb' : x ∈ b := Array.mem_def.mpr hb
      simp only [hb', if_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      intro hr
      have hr' : x ∈ ((a.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray b x) ++ b.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray a x)).dedup.mergeSort
          (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))) := by simpa using hr
      rcases (hmem x).mp hr' with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact h2 hb
      · exact h2 hx
    · have hb' : ¬ x ∈ b := fun h => hb (Array.mem_def.mp h)
      simp only [hb', if_false, decide_eq_true_eq]
      simpa using (hmem x).mpr (Or.inl ⟨hx, hb⟩)
  · rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true]
    intro x hx
    by_cases ha : x ∈ a.toList
    · have ha' : x ∈ a := Array.mem_def.mpr ha
      simp only [ha', if_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      intro hr
      have hr' : x ∈ ((a.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray b x) ++ b.toList.filter (fun x => !inArray a x)).dedup.mergeSort
          (fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))) := by simpa using hr
      rcases (hmem x).mp hr' with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
      · exact h2 hx
      · exact h2 ha
    · have ha' : ¬ x ∈ a := fun h => ha (Array.mem_def.mp h)
      simp only [ha', if_false, decide_eq_true_eq]
      simpa using (hmem x).mpr (Or.inr ⟨hx, ha⟩)
